DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
is_abi3:
- false
is_python_min:
- false
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.14.* *_cp314t
python_min:
- '3.11'
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - python
  - is_python_min
  - is_abi3
name: cftime
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.6.6"

package:
  name: cftime
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/Unidata/cftime/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}rel.tar.gz
  sha256: db03b83d55589cad78a767238c381d73270449becfb8765b562ed14e1196f6c3

build:
  number: 1
  skip:
    # one abi3 build (at python_min) plus one build per free-threading python
    - is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  variant:
    use_keys:
      - python
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
  script:
    env:
      CFTIME_LIMITED_API: ${{ "1" if is_abi3 else "0" }}
    content:
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy >=2.0.0,<3
        - cython >=0.29.20
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - numpy >=2.0.0,<3
    - setuptools >=77.0.1
    - cython >=0.29.20
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python-abi3
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
  run:
    - python
    - numpy >=2.0.0,<3

tests:
  - python:
      imports: cftime
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - "*"
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
  - files:
      source:
        - test/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - pytest
    script:
      - pytest -vv test
  - if: is_abi3
    then:
      - requirements:
          run:
            - abi3audit
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        script:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - abi3audit $SP_DIR/cftime/_cftime.abi3.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
          - if: win
            then:
              - abi3audit %SP_DIR%\\cftime\\_cftime.pyd -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}

about:
  summary: Time-handling functionality from netcdf4-python
  homepage: https://github.com/Unidata/cftime
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

  description: |
    Time-handling functionality from netcdf4-python
  documentation: https://github.com/Unidata/cftime
  repository: https://github.com/Unidata/cftime

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jhamman
    - ocefpaf
